title: Feedback after visit
description: Ask clients to rate their visit right after the appointment. Feedback request WhatsApp template for beauty businesses. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Send a few hours after the visit. Ask for a rating first; ask for a public review only to happy clients.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for visiting {{studio}} today. How did you like your {{service}} with {{stylist}}? Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
